raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.4.20"
  feature_set: full-dynamic
  llvm_major: "20"

recipe:
  name: mq-bridge
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ebaa9fac5904e94e318ff9c74eaf52ae3cfb767062b62c3e4e6f917ce2c2a94d
    patches:
      - patches/0006-build-the-wheel-with-full-dynamic.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: mq-bridge-app

    build:
      number: 0
      script:
        env:
          AWS_LC_SYS_NO_JITTER_ENTROPY: "1"
        content:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - export PROTOC="$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/protoc"
              - export LIBCLANG_PATH="$BUILD_PREFIX/lib"
              - export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-I$BUILD_PREFIX/lib/clang/${{ llvm_major }}/include -I$PREFIX/include ${CONDA_TOOLCHAIN_HOST:+--target=$CONDA_TOOLCHAIN_HOST}"
              - export PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1
              - unset RDKAFKA_STATIC LIBCURL_STATIC OPENSSL_STATIC PKG_CONFIG_ALL_STATIC
              - export PKG_CONFIG_ALL_DYNAMIC=1
              - export RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS:-} -C link-arg=-L$PREFIX/lib -C link-arg=-Wl,-rpath,$PREFIX/lib"
            else:
              - set "PROTOC=%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\protoc.exe"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim" mkdir "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim"
              - for %%F in ("%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\libclang*.dll") do copy /Y "%%F" "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim\libclang.dll"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim\libclang.dll" exit /b 1
              - set "LIBCLANG_PATH=%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim"
              - set "BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS=-I%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\lib\clang\${{ llvm_major }}\include -I%LIBRARY_INC%"
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1"
              - set "RDKAFKA_STATIC="
              - set "LIBCURL_STATIC="
              - set "OPENSSL_STATIC="
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALL_STATIC="
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALL_DYNAMIC=1"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libshim" mkdir "%SRC_DIR%\libshim"
              - for %%P in (curl ssh2 crypto ssl) do if exist "%PREFIX%\Library\lib\lib%%P.lib" copy /Y "%PREFIX%\Library\lib\lib%%P.lib" "%SRC_DIR%\libshim\%%P.lib" >nul
              - set "LIB=%SRC_DIR%\libshim;%LIB%"
          - if: linux
            then: export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="$BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS ${CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT:+--sysroot=$CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT}"
          - if: osx
            then: export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="$BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS ${CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT:+-isysroot $CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT}"
          - if: unix
            then:
              - cp "$RECIPE_DIR/pnpm-workspace.yaml" apps/mq-bridge-app/
              - cd apps/mq-bridge-app
              - pnpm import
              - pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
              - pnpm run build:ui
              - cp node_modules/@tauri-apps/api/LICENSE.spdx node_modules/@tauri-apps/api/LICENSE
              - pnpm licenses list --json | pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --json-input --output-file ../../THIRDPARTY-node-app.txt
              - cargo fetch
              - cargo auditable install --path=crates/cli --root="$PREFIX" --no-track --locked --bins --no-default-features --features "${{ feature_set }}"
              - cargo-bundle-licenses --format=yaml --output=../../THIRDPARTY-rust-app.yml
            else:
              - copy "%RECIPE_DIR%\pnpm-workspace.yaml" apps\mq-bridge-app\
              - cd apps\mq-bridge-app
              - call pnpm import
              - call pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
              - call pnpm run build:ui
              - copy node_modules\@tauri-apps\api\LICENSE.spdx node_modules\@tauri-apps\api\LICENSE
              - call pnpm licenses list --json | pnpm-licenses generate-disclaimer --json-input --output-file ..\..\THIRDPARTY-node-app.txt
              - cargo fetch
              - cargo auditable install --path=crates/cli --root="%LIBRARY_PREFIX%" --no-track --locked --bins --no-default-features --features "${{ feature_set }}"
              - cargo-bundle-licenses --format=yaml --output=..\..\THIRDPARTY-rust-app.yml

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - cargo-auditable
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cmake
        - nodejs >=24,<25
        - pnpm >=10.4,<13
        - pnpm-licenses >=2.4,<3
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: nasm
        - pkg-config
        - libprotobuf
        - libclang ${{ llvm_major }}.*
        - clang-${{ llvm_major }}
      host:
        - librdkafka >=2.12.1
        - if: win
          then: zlib

    tests:
      - script:
          - mq-bridge-app --version
          - mq-bridge-app --help
          - mqb --version
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - mq-bridge-app
            - mqb
          strict: true

    about:
      summary: Zero-code ETL bridge between message brokers, databases and HTTP endpoints
      description: |
        mq-bridge-app is a standalone application built on the mq-bridge engine.
        It moves messages between brokers, databases, files and HTTP endpoints
        from a declarative YAML or JSON route configuration, with
        transformation, filtering, retries, dead-letter queues, deduplication
        and rate limiting available as middleware. It runs as a CLI, an MCP
        server, or a daemon serving a built-in web UI.
      license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - apps/mq-bridge-app/LICENSE
        - apps/mq-bridge-app/LICENSE-MIT
        - apps/mq-bridge-app/LICENSE-APACHE
        - THIRDPARTY-node-app.txt
        - THIRDPARTY-rust-app.yml
      homepage: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
      repository: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
      documentation: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/tree/main/docs

  - package:
      name: mq-bridge-py

    build:
      number: 0
      skip: is_abi3 and not is_python_min
      python:
        version_independent: ${{ is_abi3 }}
      script:
        env:
          AWS_LC_SYS_NO_JITTER_ENTROPY: "1"
          MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS: --locked --no-default-features
        content:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - export PROTOC="$BUILD_PREFIX/bin/protoc"
              - export LIBCLANG_PATH="$BUILD_PREFIX/lib"
              - export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-I$BUILD_PREFIX/lib/clang/${{ llvm_major }}/include -I$PREFIX/include ${CONDA_TOOLCHAIN_HOST:+--target=$CONDA_TOOLCHAIN_HOST}"
              - export PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1
              - unset RDKAFKA_STATIC LIBCURL_STATIC OPENSSL_STATIC PKG_CONFIG_ALL_STATIC
              - export PKG_CONFIG_ALL_DYNAMIC=1
              - export RUSTFLAGS="${RUSTFLAGS:-} -C link-arg=-L$PREFIX/lib -C link-arg=-Wl,-rpath,$PREFIX/lib"
            else:
              - set "PROTOC=%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\protoc.exe"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim" mkdir "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim"
              - for %%F in ("%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\bin\libclang*.dll") do copy /Y "%%F" "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim\libclang.dll"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim\libclang.dll" exit /b 1
              - set "LIBCLANG_PATH=%SRC_DIR%\libclang-shim"
              - set "BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS=-I%BUILD_PREFIX%\Library\lib\clang\${{ llvm_major }}\include -I%LIBRARY_INC%"
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALLOW_CROSS=1"
              - set "RDKAFKA_STATIC="
              - set "LIBCURL_STATIC="
              - set "OPENSSL_STATIC="
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALL_STATIC="
              - set "PKG_CONFIG_ALL_DYNAMIC=1"
              - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\libshim" mkdir "%SRC_DIR%\libshim"
              - for %%P in (curl ssh2 crypto ssl) do if exist "%PREFIX%\Library\lib\lib%%P.lib" copy /Y "%PREFIX%\Library\lib\lib%%P.lib" "%SRC_DIR%\libshim\%%P.lib" >nul
              - set "LIB=%SRC_DIR%\libshim;%LIB%"
          - if: linux
            then: export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="$BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS ${CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT:+--sysroot=$CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT}"
          - if: osx
            then: export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="$BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS ${CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT:+-isysroot $CONDA_BUILD_SYSROOT}"
          - cargo fetch
          - if: unix
            then: cd python/mq-bridge-py
            else: cd python\mq-bridge-py
          - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
          - if: unix
            then: cargo-bundle-licenses --format=yaml --output=../../THIRDPARTY-rust-py.yml
            else: cargo-bundle-licenses --format=yaml --output=..\..\THIRDPARTY-rust-py.yml

    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
        - cargo-bundle-licenses
        - cmake
        - if: unix
          then: make
        - if: win
          then: nasm
        - pkg-config
        - libprotobuf
        - libclang ${{ llvm_major }}.*
        - clang-${{ llvm_major }}
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - maturin >=1.7,<2
      host:
        - python
        - if: is_abi3
          then: python-abi3
        - pip
        - maturin >=1.7,<2
        - librdkafka >=2.12.1
        - if: win
          then: zlib
      run:
        - python
        - typing_extensions >=4.0

    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - mq_bridge
            - mq_bridge.config
          python_version:
            - if: is_abi3
              then: ${{ python_min }}.*
            - "*"
          pip_check: true
      - if: is_abi3
        then:
          requirements:
            run:
              - abi3audit
          script:
            - if: unix
              then: abi3audit $SP_DIR/mq_bridge/_mq_bridge.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
              else: abi3audit %SP_DIR%\mq_bridge\_mq_bridge.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}

    about:
      summary: Python bindings for mq-bridge, an async message-bridging library
      description: |
        Thin Python bindings for the Rust mq-bridge engine. They expose
        Publisher, Consumer and Route objects that connect message brokers,
        databases, files, HTTP/WebSocket endpoints and in-memory channels
        behind one small set of traits, with batch-aware processing and
        acknowledgement sequencing. Routes can be declared in code or loaded
        from YAML/JSON, and custom endpoints and middleware can be registered
        from Python or loaded as native plugins.
      license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
      license_file:
        - python/mq-bridge-py/LICENSE.python
        - python/mq-bridge-py/LICENSE-MIT.python
        - python/mq-bridge-py/LICENSE-APACHE.python
        - THIRDPARTY-rust-py.yml
      homepage: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
      repository: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
      documentation: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/tree/main/python/mq-bridge-py

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
  repository: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge
  documentation: https://github.com/marcomq/mq-bridge/tree/main/docs
  license: MIT OR Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - LICENSE-MIT
    - LICENSE-APACHE
  summary: Asynchronous message bridging between brokers, databases and HTTP endpoints
  description: |
    mq-bridge moves messages between message brokers, databases, files,
    HTTP/WebSocket endpoints and in-memory channels, giving each transport the
    same message, consumer and publisher interfaces and composing them into
    routes that can transform, filter, batch, retry, rate-limit, deduplicate or
    fan out along the way.

    This recipe produces two packages: `mq-bridge-app`, the zero-code ETL
    application driven by a YAML or JSON route configuration, and
    `mq-bridge-py`, the Python bindings for the engine.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - phreed
